chunks: 4165 - Al-Faḍl and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

A group of people came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said to him: “A cow of ours overpowered us and became difficult for us to handle, so we struck it with the sword.” So he instructed them to eat it.

key_terms.اسْتَصْعَبَتْ: it became difficult and unmanageable; describing the animal’s resistance
key_terms.السَّيْفِ: the sword; the instrument used to strike the animal
key_terms.بَقَرَةً: a cow; the animal being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.بِأَكْلِهَا: to eat it; indicating permission for its consumption
key_terms.غَلَبَتْنَا: it overpowered us; indicating loss of control over the animal

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat an animal that was struck with a sword when it became impossible to control?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that when a cow became uncontrollable and was struck with a sword, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم permitted its consumption. The report is relevant to jurisprudential discussions on slaughter and the permissibility of eating an animal killed in a constrained situation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4165 - Al-Fadl and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) that he said:

"A group of people came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) and said to him: 'A cow of ours overpowered us and became difficult to handle, so we struck it with a sword.'
Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) instructed them to eat it."
